fields.label: Named identity
fields.rationale: A canonical name is the minimum a dossier can carry.

fields.label: Official website
fields.rationale: The primary source for verifying what the company actually does.

fields.label: Legal entity name
fields.rationale: Separates the trading brand from the registered entity.

fields.label: Recorded aliases
fields.rationale: Lets dataset spellings resolve to one company instead of several.

fields.label: Industry classification
fields.rationale: A company with no industry cannot be found by sector.

fields.label: National taxonomy placement
fields.rationale: Places the company in the 731-node sector tree.

fields.label: At least one evidence source
fields.rationale: No claim about the company without a source and a checked date.

fields.label: Verification within 180 days
fields.rationale: A stale dossier is presented as current when it is not.

fields.label: Sourced operating location
fields.rationale: Province is the recruiter’s first geographic filter.

fields.label: Sourced scale measure
fields.rationale: Headcount, revenue or sites, verbatim and dated.

fields.label: Established footprint band
fields.rationale: Lets an industry be read by company size without inventing one.

fields.label: Evidenced capability
fields.rationale: What the company actually operates, not just its sector.

fields.label: Corporate relationship
fields.rationale: Group and subsidiary structure, so headcount is never double-counted.
